nodes.label: Shajgoj E-Commerce Platform
nodes.rationale: High-performance modern e-commerce web application built for beauty and cosmetic products.

nodes.label: Shajgoj.bd Wordmark Logo (v2)
nodes.description: Horizontal wordmark reading 'SHAJGOJ' in bold geometric sans-serif capitals with a rose/dusty-pink left-to-right gradient (deep rose to light mauve), with a vertically rotated '.bd' suffix at the right edge on a transparent/white background.
nodes.rationale: Text-only wordmark suits header, mobile header, footer, auth and admin placements; the vertical '.bd' marks the Bangladesh domain without widening the logo; rose palette signals a beauty/cosmetics brand.

nodes.label: Rose-to-Mauve Gradient Brand Palette
nodes.rationale: Soft rose/pink tones associated with beauty and cosmetics retail; gradient adds depth to a flat wordmark.

nodes.label: Favicon (Shajgoj Brand Mark)
nodes.description: High-res favicon: two offset half-ring arcs (pink gradient on top, gold gradient on bottom) interlocking around a central circle to form a stylized S monogram on a transparent background.

nodes.label: Pink-Gold Brand Gradient Palette
nodes.rationale: Soft pink-to-rose and bronze-to-light-gold gradients convey a beauty/cosmetics, premium feel consistent with a beauty e-commerce brand.

nodes.label: Stylized S Monogram Logo
nodes.rationale: Two horizontally offset semicircular rings suggest the letter S for Shajgoj while also reading as a ring/circle, a compact mark suitable for favicon and small UI sizes.

nodes.label: SHAJGOJ.bd Main Logo (wordmark)
nodes.description: Horizontal wordmark logo reading 'SHAJGOJ' in bold uppercase geometric sans-serif with a small rotated '.bd' suffix set vertically at the right edge. Letters use a left-to-right gradient from deep rose/berry to muted dusty pink on a transparent/white background. Used as the brand logo in header, mobile header, footer, auth and admin screens.

nodes.label: Shajgoj.bd Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: Rose-to-dusty-pink gradient palette and bold geometric type signal a beauty/cosmetics e-commerce brand targeting Bangladesh (.bd domain).

nodes.label: Shajgoj.bd Favicon (Final)
nodes.description: High-res square brand favicon/logo mark on a transparent background: two offset half-rings, a pink gradient upper arc and a gold gradient lower arc, shifted horizontally so together they read as a stylized 'S' ring for Shajgoj.

nodes.label: Pink-Gold Brand Gradient Palette
nodes.rationale: A soft-to-deep pink gradient (about #E6B8BE to #E86A88) paired with a gold gradient (about #B38B3C to #F0D478) suggests beauty/cosmetics and a premium feel, which suits a beauty e-commerce brand.

nodes.label: Stylized S Ring Monogram
nodes.rationale: Splitting a ring into two offset semicircles makes an abstract 'S' for Shajgoj. It is a simple geometric shape that stays readable at small favicon sizes.

nodes.label: Pink-to-Gold Brand Gradient Palette
nodes.rationale: Soft pink to rose gradient paired with a bronze to light gold gradient conveys a beauty/cosmetics brand identity.

nodes.label: Shajgoj Footer Logo Mark (split pink/gold ring)
nodes.norm_label: shajgoj footer logo mark (split pink/gold ring)
nodes.rationale: Brand icon asset served from /public for the site footer: two offset half-rings (pink gradient top, gold gradient bottom) forming a stylized 'S'/ring on a transparent background, a textless mark for compact placement.

nodes.label: Hamburger Menu Icon (Black)
nodes.rationale: 30x16 SVG menu button icon with three staggered-width horizontal bars (20, 30, 25px) filled #222; used as mobile navigation toggle in header UI.

nodes.label: Globe Icon (globe.svg)
nodes.description: 16x16 monochrome (#666) outline globe icon with latitude/longitude meridian paths, clipped to a square clipPath. Matches the default create-next-app scaffold asset typically used for an external 'Go to nextjs.org' link.
nodes.rationale: Likely leftover from the Next.js starter template rather than a custom Shajgoj brand asset.
